meta.name: best-practices
meta.description: Apply modern web development best practices for security, compatibility, and code quality. Use when asked to "apply best practices", "security audit", "modernize code", "code quality review", or "check for vulnerabilities".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让代码更安全、更兼容、更规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想在改动前检查代码的安全性、兼容性和质量
copy.tagline_en: Harden your code with modern web best practices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to enforce security and quality standards in your web code

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按照现代 Web 开发标准审查和修改代码,重点加强安全(如强制 HTTPS、设置安全头)、保证浏览器兼容性,并提升代码质量。
howto.when: 当用户提到「apply best practices」「security audit」「code quality review」等关键词时触发。

say.text: 请对我的项目做一次安全审计。
say.note: Claude 会检查并修复安全配置。

say.text: 帮我检查代码里有没有已知漏洞。
say.note: 会运行依赖检查并给出修复建议。

say.text: 请按现代最佳实践重构这段代码。
say.note: 会提升兼容性和代码质量。

howto.what_en: Claude will review and modify code following modern web standards, focusing on security (enforcing HTTPS, security headers), browser compatibility, and code quality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to 'apply best practices', 'security audit', 'code quality review', etc.

say_en.text: Please run a security audit on my project.
say_en.note: Claude will check and fix security configurations.

say_en.text: Check my code for known vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: It will run dependency checks and suggest fixes.

say_en.text: Refactor this code to modern best practices.
say_en.note: It will improve compatibility and code quality.
